description: Signal-peptide assessment of AcrIIC1 vs Neisseria exported controls; cysteine conservation map; side-by-side redox potential number line
code:
import requests, re, time
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist-curation/1.0"}
QUERY="MANKTYKIGKNAGYDGCGLCLAAISENEAIKVKYLRDICPDYDGDDKAEDWLRWGTDSRVKAAALEMEQYAYTSVGMASCWEFVEL"

KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,
    'I':4.5,'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
def kd_profile(s,w=9):
    v=[KD.get(c,0) for c in s]
    return np.array([np.mean(v[max(0,i-w//2):i+w//2+1]) for i in range(len(s))])

# controls: N. meningitidis DsbA-1 (lipoprotein, signal peptide) and TrxA (cytoplasmic)
ctl={}
for acc,lab in [("Q9K189","NmDsbA-1 (periplasmic lipoprotein)"),("Q9JYY9","NmThioredoxin (cytoplasmic)"),
                ("Q9K1N8","NmMsrA/B PilB (exported)")]:
    e=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json",headers=H,timeout=60).json()
    ctl[lab]=e["sequence"]["value"]
    sp=[f for f in e.get("features",[]) if f["type"] in ("Signal","Lipidation","Chain","Transit peptide")]
    print(lab, acc, "len",len(ctl[lab]))
    for f in sp[:4]: print("    ",f["type"],f["location"]["start"]["value"],"-",f["location"]["end"]["value"],f.get("description"))
    time.sleep(0.1)

print("\n--- N-terminal 30 aa comparison ---")
def report(name,s):
    p=kd_profile(s[:40])
    n=s[:30]
    lipo=re.search(r"[LVIFA][ASTVILG][GAS]C",s[:40])
    tat=re.search(r"RR[^DE][FGAVML][LITMVF]",s[:30])
    print(f"{name[:40]:42s} Nterm30={n}")
    print(f"{'':42s} max KD(window9, res1-40)={p.max():+.2f} at {int(p.argmax())+1}; "
          f"net charge(1-10)={sum(1 for c in s[:10] if c in 'KR')-sum(1 for c in s[:10] if c in 'DE'):+d}; "
          f"lipobox={lipo.group() if lipo else 'none'}; TatRR={tat.group() if tat else 'none'}")
report("AcrIIC1 (A0A2D0TCG3)",QUERY)
for k,v in ctl.items(): report(k,v)

# ---------- FIGURE ----------
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13.5,9))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,height_ratios=[1,1.15],hspace=0.45,wspace=0.28)

# panel A: KD profile
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
for name,s,st in [("AcrIIC1 (A0A2D0TCG3)",QUERY,"-"),("NmDsbA-1 lipoprotein",ctl["NmDsbA-1 (periplasmic lipoprotein)"],"--"),
                  ("NmPilB MsrA/B exported",ctl["NmMsrA/B PilB (exported)"],":"),
                  ("NmThioredoxin cytoplasmic",ctl["NmThioredoxin (cytoplasmic)"],"-.")]:
    p=kd_profile(s[:45]); ax.plot(range(1,len(p)+1),p,st,label=name,lw=1.9)
ax.axhline(1.6,color="grey",lw=1,ls=":"); ax.text(30,1.75,"signal-peptide h-region\nthreshold (~1.6)",fontsize=7,color="grey")
ax.set_xlabel("residue"); ax.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle (window 9)")
ax.set_title("A  N-terminal hydrophobicity: AcrIIC1 has no h-region",fontsize=10,loc="left")
ax.legend(fontsize=7)

# panel B: cysteine conservation
cons=pd.read_csv("acrIIC1_cys_conservation.csv")
cons=cons[~cons.homolog.str.contains("7X31")]
cons=cons.sort_values("pct_id",ascending=True)
ax2=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
mat=(cons[["q_C17","q_C80"]]=="C").astype(int).values
ax2.imshow(mat,cmap="RdYlGn",aspect="auto",vmin=0,vmax=1)
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(cons)))
ax2.set_yticklabels([h.split("|")[0].split(" hypo")[0].split(" anti")[0].split(" MAG")[0][:34] for h in cons.homolog],fontsize=6)
ax2.set_xticks([0,1]); ax2.set_xticklabels(["pos. 17","pos. 80"],fontsize=8)
for i in range(len(cons)):
    for j,c in enumerate(["q_C17","q_C80"]):
        ax2.text(j,i,cons[c].values[i],ha="center",va="center",fontsize=6)
    ax2.text(2.1,i,f"{cons.pct_id.values[i]:.0f}%  nCys={cons.nCys.values[i]}",fontsize=6,va="center")
ax2.set_xlim(-0.5,3.6)
ax2.set_title("B  Residue aligned to NmeAcrIIC1 Cys17 / Cys80\n(green = cysteine retained)",fontsize=10,loc="left")

# panel C: redox potential number line
ax3=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,:])
items=[
 ("N. meningitidis DsbA1/2/3 (periplasmic oxidase), E°' = -80 mV\nLafaye 2009 PMID 19631659", -80, None, "#b2182b"),
 ("E. coli periplasm steady state, roGFP2: -228 mV (WT),\n-243 mV (ΔdsbA)  Knoke 2023 PMID 37413765", -228, (-243,-228), "#ef8a62"),
 ("'normal cytoplasmic values' cited by Zhao 2022 =\neukaryotic cytosol GSH/GSSG range (Go & Jones reviews)", -230, (-260,-200), "#999999"),
 ("Redox buffers actually used by Zhao 2022\n(AcrIIC1 reduced across this whole range)", -280, (-360,-200), "#4393c3"),
 ("M. tuberculosis TrxB/TrxC E°' -262 / -269 mV\n(Trx-class reference) PMID 18723612", -265, (-269,-262), "#2166ac"),
 ("NmeAcrIIC1 Cys17-Cys80 switch potential\nNEVER MEASURED (no E°' reported)", None, None, "k"),
]
y=0
for lab,pt,rng,col in items:
    if rng: ax3.plot([rng[0],rng[1]],[y,y],lw=9,color=col,alpha=0.75,solid_capstyle="butt")
    if pt is not None: ax3.plot([pt],[y],"o",color=col,ms=9,mec="k",mew=0.6)
    if pt is None:
        ax3.annotate("?",(-290,y),fontsize=26,ha="center",va="center",color="crimson",weight="bold")
        ax3.plot([-380,-60],[y,y],lw=1.2,ls=":",color="crimson")
    ax3.text(-55,y,lab,fontsize=8,va="center")
    y-=1
ax3.set_xlim(-390,80); ax3.set_ylim(y+0.5,0.8)
ax3.set_yticks([]); ax3.set_xlabel("standard / steady-state thiol redox potential E (mV, pH 7)")
ax3.set_title("C  The two numbers the hypothesis asks to compare: only one of them exists",fontsize=10,loc="left")
ax3.grid(axis="x",alpha=0.3)
plt.show()
